macros.name: wrapoverhang
macros.doc: The default overhang is given by the length \wrapoverhang, which is 0pt normally but can be changed using \setlength.

envs.name: wrapfigure
envs.doc: Wrapfig.sty provides the environments wrapfigure and wraptable for typesetting a narrow float at the edge of the text, and making the text wrap around it.
